title: Medical Medium & His Dad Had A Coconut Farm
text: Coconut water [music] with the young coconuts you get clear water. It's like It's a gold. God's gift >> [music] >> to this planet. Can they fix things in people? Right. I just like the taste as a drink. At 6 years old you were telling everybody it was a medicine. [music] Yeah, you were saying it helped their brain. But we didn't have the coconut water for people. But I stumbled across some property that had a couple [music] of hundred coconut trees and the guy wanted out and I took it over and then [music] we went to work in it. 9 months later beautiful crop came in. So Dad, there was a problem though, right? Yeah, nobody wanted them. Nobody drank it. There was no coconut water [music] market. You were sending sick people coconuts for free. >> [music] >> Yeah, I didn't care. I just wanted them to have it. And you would have them in your office when people came in there to see you. Oh yeah, I would crack them open for people and just have them drink it right there. And they loved it. [music] >> They would just be drinking the coconut water fresh from the coconuts. You would stock [music] us up there at my office. Everybody would be drinking them every day. It was amazing. Yeah.
